item.title: Show HN: Tmail – The Mailbox You Own
item.summary: Access locally or remotely with authenticated service. Encrypt your communications E2E by publishing your PGP key to your node. Minimal distraction free UI. Optional 2FA access for additional security. Host on linux, macOS, or termux Find it here! https://gitlab.com/here_forawhile/tmail Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49304043 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
